projectDescription: A React-based developer portfolio with a classified intelligence dossier aesthetic, featuring a dark cyberpunk UI, animated skill meters, case study deep-dives, and a writing archive.
keyFeatures: Classified intelligence dossier aesthetic with dark cyberpunk color palette (ink/violet/lime/magenta/cyan)
Animated LED proficiency meters with Framer Motion for skills visualization
RedactedReveal component — animated text unredaction effect on scroll
ClassificationStamp component with UNCLASSIFIED → TOP SECRET clearance levels
Scrollable case study deep-dives with sticky sidebar navigation and incident logs
Split-panel writing archive with live document preview on hover
Contact form styled as an encrypted transmission terminal
Hash-based client-side routing via React Router with static HTML pre-rendering for each route
Vite build system with ES module preloading and Tailwind CSS utility classes
Responsive layout with IBM Plex Sans Condensed display font and JetBrains Mono for code/UI labels
publicApiSurface: about.js → historyLogs: Array<{ id, date, classification, text, isRedacted? }>, behaviorFlags: string[]
projects.js → projects: Array<{ id, title, codename, status, tech, description, fullDescription, links, dataSource }>
skills.js → skillCategories: Array<{ category, skills: Array<{ name, proficiency: 1-5 }> }>
articles.js → articles: Array<{ id, type, title, date, readTime, abstract, content }>
caseStudies.js → caseStudies: Array<{ id, title, sections: Array<{ id, title, content, type?, logs? }> }>
